scenarioMethod: Empirical analogue: BAU uses each country’s 2016–2026 observed annualized rates; Moderate and Accelerated use median annualized rates of countries in those observed archetypes. Emissions grow at the corresponding observed annualized emissions rate. Shares are assumptions shown for context, not causal inputs to the emissions formula. No uncertainty interval is estimated.
